items.title: Man City latest: 'Pep who?' - Keane impressed by 'statement' win at Anfield

items.description: The chant from The Kop went up early. "You haven't won a trophy since 1976." It was a reference to Manchester City's League Cup triumph, the last major honour that the club picked up prior to the period of ownership that now finds itself under such scrutiny.
